GroupInvite.title: GroupInvite
GroupInvite.description: Invite code lookup entry allowing signed-in users with an exact 6-char code to join a guardian group.

groupName.description: Display name of the guardian group.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the group creator.

unlockDurationSeconds.description: Cooldown seconds required before a resolution can unlock.

GuardianGroup.title: GuardianGroup
GuardianGroup.description: In-app safety guardian group coordinating encrypted location reporting and consensus resolutions.

name.description: Name of the safety guardian group.

inviteCode.description: Uppercase alphanumeric code shared with trusted members.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator.

memberUids.description: Bounded list (max 30) of authorized member UIDs.

unlockDurationSeconds.description: Notice/veto window in seconds before a resolution can unlock.

GroupMember.title: GroupMember
GroupMember.description: Per-member consent, encrypted tracking toggle, and battery status within a guardian group.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member.

displayName.description: Display nickname shown inside the guardian group.

trackingEnabled.description: Whether encrypted location reporting is enabled.

consentAccepted.description: Whether the member explicitly signed the emergency authorization agreement.

lastReportAtMs.description: Client epoch millis of the last encrypted upload.

GroupMessage.title: GroupMessage
GroupMessage.description: In-app chat message or automated resolution notification inside a guardian group.

relatedResolutionId.description: Optional ID of an associated resolution.

memberUids.description: Denormalized group member UIDs for secure list queries.

GuardianResolution.title: GuardianResolution
GuardianResolution.description: Emergency location-view resolution initiated by another member with target one-vote veto and cooldown.

initiatorUid.description: UID of the member initiating the resolution (must differ from targetUid).

targetUid.description: UID of the member whose encrypted location is requested.

targetName.description: Display name of the target member.

reason.description: Reason for requesting emergency location view.

targetVetoed.description: True if target exercised their exclusive one-vote veto.

memberUids.description: Denormalized group member UIDs for secure list queries.

unlockAt.description: Earliest server time when resolution can transition to UNLOCKED.

KeyEscrow.title: KeyEscrow
KeyEscrow.description: AES-256-GCM key escrow document readable by group members only after an UNLOCKED non-vetoed resolution.

escrowedAesKeyB64.description: Base64-encoded AES-256 key released only upon resolution unlock.

unlockedByResolutionId.description: Resolution ID linking an UNLOCKED non-vetoed resolution.

EncryptedTrackPoint.title: EncryptedTrackPoint
EncryptedTrackPoint.description: End-to-end AES-256-GCM encrypted location breadcrumb stored in Firestore without plaintext coordinates.

ownerUid.description: UID of the member uploading the ciphertext.

encryptedPayload.description: AES-256-GCM ivBase64:cipherBase64 ciphertext containing lat, lng, speed, accuracy.

recordedAtMs.description: Client capture timestamp in epoch ms.

memberUids.description: Denormalized group member UIDs for secure list queries.

/group_invites/{inviteCode}.description: Invite code lookup records for joining a guardian group.

/guardian_groups/{groupId}.description: Guardian group metadata and bounded member UID list.

/guardian_groups/{groupId}/members/{memb.description: Member consent status, tracking toggle, and battery telemetry.

/guardian_groups/{groupId}/messages/{mes.description: In-app guardian group chat and resolution notifications.

/guardian_groups/{groupId}/resolutions/{.description: Consensus resolutions with cooldown and target one-vote veto.

/guardian_groups/{groupId}/key_escrows/{.description: Escrowed AES keys gated by an unlocked non-vetoed resolution.
